name: Serial No-baro_imei
label: IMEI
description: Required by server validation when the Item belongs to a GPS device Item Group - not by reqd, which would break non-GPS serials. Normalised to 15 digits and Luhn-checked in baro_core.baro_devices.handlers.validate_serial_no (docs/10 #3, docs/31 #3).

name: Serial No-baro_device_status
label: BARO Device Status
options:
In-Stock
Reserved
Allocated
Installed
Active
Faulty
RMA
Returned
Disposed
description: Derived: Baro Device Assignment and Baro Device RMA controllers are the authority (docs/10 #3). Not the same axis as standard status, which stays stock semantics. Enforced server-side: baro_core.baro_devices.handlers.validate_serial_no rejects a manual change by any role except BARO Stock Manager's In-Stock/Reserved/Allocated triangle - read_only in JSON would not achieve that, because read_only is a UI property and never an authority (docs/30 #7).

name: Serial No-baro_firmware_version
label: Current Firmware
description: Derived: latest Baro Firmware History row for this serial (docs/10 #3). Written only by baro_core.derive.recompute_firmware_version.

name: Serial No-baro_last_comm_at
label: Last Communication
description: Integration-written: max of Baro Platform Mapping.baro_last_comm_at across enabled platforms (docs/10 #3). Permlevel 1 so presence detail is not automatic for every role that can see the device (docs/41 #3). The device-inactive scheduler reads it.

name: Installation Note-baro_vehicle
label: Vehicle
description: Set at installation; validated to match the assignment's vehicle (docs/10 #3).

name: Installation Note-baro_assignment
label: Device Assignment
description: The submit of the assignment is what activates billing (docs/10 #3).

name: Installation Note-baro_activation_status
label: Platform Activation
description: Workflow/connector-written, never by the installer (docs/10 #3, docs/40 #4).

name: Installation Note-baro_customer_signature
label: Customer Sign-off
description: Satisfies the blueprint's customer sign-off requirement. Readable by Support/Supervisor, never emitted by a public print format (docs/41 #3).

name: Installation Note-baro_quality_inspection
label: Inspection
description: Set when quality approves; gates the Installed-to-Active transition (docs/10 #3, docs/40 #3).

name: Customer-baro_fleet_account
label: Fleet Account
description: Segmentation; drives portal and scheduling defaults later (docs/10 #3).

name: Customer-baro_platform_customer_ref
label: Platform Account Ref
description: The external platform's own account id, for inbound event routing (docs/10 #3). Searchable, deliberately NOT unique: one external account may map to two BARO legal entities.

name: Subscription-baro_service_level
label: Service Level
description: Maps to SLA and support policy later; kept on Subscription rather than Contract (docs/10 #3).

name: Quality Inspection-baro_vehicle
label: Vehicle
description: Lets quality reporting slice by fleet (docs/10 #3).

name: Issue-baro_vehicle
label: Vehicle
description: Support tickets sliced by vehicle. Defined now so the link exists when Helpdesk arrives (docs/10 #3, docs/90).
